title: Request for information on savings rate publication
not_questions: Adobe Journey Optimizer is out of scope.
Use the rate sheet supplied by Treasury for all illustrations.

questions.label: A.1
questions.text: Describe the AEM Sites workflow for a Treasury editor to correct an annual percentage yield and obtain a second approval before publication.

questions.label: A.2
questions.text: Explain how AEM Sites would receive the approved savings disclosures currently held in Sitecore. Account for retired disclosures that still have a public address.

questions.label: A.3
questions.text: Show how AEM Sites would display separate rates for the same account in two postal districts without copying the entire product page.

questions.label: A.4
questions.text: Set out the AEM Sites rollback rehearsal you would run if a rate sheet reached the public website one business day early.

questions.label: B.1
questions.text: Specify which Customer Journey Analytics events you would reconcile against Snowflake to distinguish a comparison visit from an application start.

questions.label: B.2
questions.text: Explain how Customer Journey Analytics would distinguish changes in mobile traffic from a decline in use of the savings calculator.

questions.label: B.3
questions.text: Describe the validation evidence that Marketing and Treasury could use to sign off the comparison report.

questions.label: B.4
questions.text: Identify the Customer Journey Analytics metric that would reveal repeated visits to an expired rate bulletin. Give its denominator.

questions.label: C.1
questions.text: Provide the names and roles of your proposed commercial contact and escalation contact for the duration of the engagement.

questions.label: C.2
questions.text: State the fixed fee for the rehearsal and identify the event that makes the invoice payable.

questions.label: C.3
questions.text: Supply a reference from a financial institution that changed rates across regional sites during your delivery.

questions.label: C.4
questions.text: Describe how your firm would notify the bank about a conflict of interest involving its Treasury adviser.
